map.分镜数量怎么定？: How is the number of shots decided?
map.一般按'开场—痛点—方案—演示—信任—行动'六段式，短视频 15 秒可压到 3–: The usual structure is six segments: 'hook - pain point - solution - demo - trust - action', and a 15-second short video can be compressed to 3-4 shots. With fewer shots each carries more information; with more, the pace is more relaxed. This tool divides the duration evenly, and the specific structure is decided by the script idea.
